description: Standing room for two and only if they know each other. A cutting machine bolted to the bench with a tray of swarf under it and a wire brush on a chain. Blanks on the wall in banks, thousands of them, sorted by profile in a system that is either genius or the residue of forty years. A vice, a set of files rolled in canvas, and a card by the till: I CUT KEYS. I OPEN DOORS. THEY ARE DIFFERENT SERVICES AND I DO NOT DO THE SECOND ONE WITHOUT THE FIRST.

window.description: Four feet of glass beside the door with a board of key blanks hung across it on nails, so what the street sees through the window is about six hundred keys in silhouette and no room at all.
window.name: the blank board

name: Skeleton Crew — The Shop
